name: Refactoring Pairs (Same-Behavior)
description: A refactor of working code that must pass the exact same tests as the original — proof the refactor preserved behavior.
executionEnv: polyglot sandbox (python3 / node / java / go / rustc / gcc / g++ / ruby / php / mono)

fields.label: Tests
fields.help: Both the original and refactored code must pass these. For Java/Go/Rust/C++: original_code and refactored_code are each concatenated directly with tests (not wrapped in a synthesized entrypoint) -- tests must supply a complete main()/entrypoint itself. For Java specifically, the convention is to leave original_code's class unclosed (e.g. end after 'public class Main {' and its methods, no closing brace) and have tests supply the rest of the method body plus the closing brace.
